# Mariana Ordoñez Alarcón

> Ecommerce graphic designer, 8 years. Shopify storefronts, Amazon A+ content and
> product detail page imagery, email and paid social campaign creative for DTC brands
> and retail marketplaces. Based in Bogotá, Colombia; works remotely on US hours (UTC-5).

Currently designing the digital shelf for Ferrero USA brands (Kinder, Nutella, Ferrero
Rocher, Tic Tac, Butterfinger) across Amazon, Walmart and Instacart at eStoreLabs.
Available for full-time remote ecommerce, marketing and creative design roles.

Contact: marianaordonez04@gmail.com

- [Casabianca Cycling Apparel](https://mordonez.com/work/casabianca-apparel-cro/): four years designing and optimising a Shopify storefront, product pages, collections, checkout and brand system

## Skills

Marketplace and digital shelf: Amazon A+ Content and Premium A+, listing and hero images,
infographics, image carousels, Amazon Brand Stores, variant and bundle selectors, Walmart
and Instacart specs, Salsify syndication.
Shopify and conversion: Shopify storefront and theme design, product detail pages,
collections, landing pages, checkout flow, conversion rate optimization, A/B test variants.
Campaign and brand creative: paid social and Meta ad creative, Klaviyo email and lifecycle
templates, seasonal campaigns, brand and visual identity, product photography and retouching.
Product and systems: Figma design systems and components, wireframing, prototyping,
usability testing, developer handoff.
Tools: Figma, Shopify, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, InDesign, Canva,
Salsify, Klaviyo, HTML, CSS, React basics, generative AI tools.
